AttributeList.Text: Per-equipment automatic-control layer for the shredding/material-recovery plant (REQ-001..022). Paradigm: combinational chained-permissive interlock/mapping (C-113 'no' - no phase memory in this block; the plant sequencer and equipment FBs hold the state). One network per machine, in material-train order, each mapping field feedback in, computing the auto start/shutdown permissives from PlantControl.Status and neighbour UPSEnable/ShutdownComplete, driving the physical output, and calling the equipment FB. Composed from the chained-permissive-enable pattern. Net 17 (feed conveyor) is freeform fwd/rev per C-116/C-117 (reversal pause enforced inside MotorFwdRevSystem). Author: lad-coder (gen-block-new). Rev 1, 2026-07-20.
Plant Automatic Control

Incline feed VSD (MotorVSDInst2). Running-fwd confirmation taken from the rotation sensor (inferred VSD-running mapping - review). Holds during shutdown until the link conveyor and the third-party JOB9001 plant have both completed shutdown (REQ-003/014); starts once the air-separator VSD is enabled (REQ-004).
Incline Feed Conveyor Automatic Control

Link conveyor (MotorStarterInst4), the designated first machine. Gated by the third-party JOB9001 interlock; holds through shutdown until JOB9001 signals its own shutdown complete (REQ-014). On first auto-start it requests the plant pre-start warning once (one-shot via PlantControl.PositiveEdgeArray[4]), cleared when the pre-start output energises (REQ-015).
Link Conveyor Automatic Control

Dust filter unit 1 (FilterUnitInst2). Remote-operational, running(=ready) and fault feedbacks brought in; fault reset echoed to the physical unit (REQ-019). Fan up-to-speed delay set from the plant fan-start time (REQ-020); see block header re C-308. Starts once the sorter conveyor VSD is enabled; holds during shutdown until fans-shutdown-ready (REQ-003/013).
Dust Filter Unit 1 Automatic Control
Dust filter unit 2 (FilterUnitInst3), identical shape to unit 1 (REQ-019/020). Starts once the sorter conveyor VSD is enabled; holds until fans-shutdown-ready.
Dust Filter Unit 2 Automatic Control

Air-separator VSD (AirStarInst1), a bus-coupled drive with no discrete start output. Running confirmed over comms (MachineRunning). Alternative start permissive: discharge-conveyor VSD plus both dust filters enabled, OR discharge-conveyor VSD plus the third-party link-out signal (REQ-021). Holds during shutdown until the incline feed conveyor has shut down (REQ-003).
Air-Separator VSD Automatic Control

Discharge conveyor VSD (MotorVSDInst1). Treats its rotation sensor as running-forward confirmation (REQ-012; bypass handling deferred - review). Starts once the overband magnet and ECS are enabled; holds during shutdown until the air-separator VSD has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Discharge Conveyor VSD Automatic Control

Metal collection conveyor (MotorStarterInst3). Gated by the magnet-circuit enable (REQ-013); starts on that plant flag rather than an upstream UPSEnable. Holds during shutdown until the overband magnet has shut down (REQ-003).
Metal Collection Conveyor Automatic Control

Overband magnet (MotorStarterInst8), confirmed on run feedback only (no rotation sensor). Starts once the metal collection conveyor is enabled; holds during shutdown until the discharge conveyor VSD has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Overband Magnet Automatic Control

Equipment control system (ECSControlInst1). Fault, mode (auto/hand/setting), ready, running, feeder/charge and rotor status brought in; auto-start and reset outputs driven (REQ-018). Starts once the sorter conveyor VSD is enabled; holds during shutdown until the discharge conveyor VSD has shut down (REQ-003).
Equipment Control System Automatic Control

Sorter feed conveyor VSD (MotorVSDInst3). Running-fwd from rotation sensor (inferred - review). Only permitted to start while the optical sorter is ready and not faulted, and the ejected and residual conveyors are enabled (REQ-017/004). Holds during shutdown until the ECS has shut down (REQ-003).
Sorter Conveyor VSD Automatic Control

Optical sorter (TomraControlInst1). Hardwired ready/running/comms-fault brought in and the run command driven to the sorter (REQ-017). Comms data words (a separate block owns them) deliberately not wired here. Starts once the ejected and residual conveyors are enabled; holds during shutdown until the sorter conveyor VSD has shut down (REQ-003).
Optical Sorter Automatic Control
Drum separator (MotorStarterInst5), confirmed on run feedback only. Gated by the drum-separator enable (REQ-013); holds during shutdown until drum-shutdown-ready (REQ-003).
Drum Separator Automatic Control
Ejected material conveyor (MotorStarterInst6). Gated by the general enable (REQ-013); holds during shutdown until the optical sorter has shut down (REQ-003).
Ejected Material Conveyor Automatic Control
Residual material conveyor (MotorStarterInst7). Starts once disc spreaders 1 and 2 are enabled; holds during shutdown until the optical sorter has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Residual Material Conveyor Automatic Control

Disc spreader unit 1 (MotorStarterInst1), confirmed on run feedback only. Starts once the feed conveyor is enabled; holds during shutdown until the residual material conveyor has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Disc Spreader Unit 1 Automatic Control
Disc spreader unit 2 (MotorStarterInst2), identical shape to unit 1. Starts once the feed conveyor is enabled; holds until the residual material conveyor has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Disc Spreader Unit 2 Automatic Control

Shredder feed conveyor (MotorFwdRevInst1), forward/reverse. Runs forward when the shredder is ready to receive (its upstream-enable), reverses on the general enable to back material off the shredder when it is not ready (REQ-016). Reverse selection is FREEFORM (no admitted pattern for fwd/rev); the stopped-before-reverse pause is enforced inside MotorFwdRevSystem (C-117). Holds during shutdown until disc spreaders 1 and 2 have shut down (REQ-003).
Feed Conveyor Automatic Control

Shredder (ShredderControlInst1), commanded through its FB (no discrete start; internal sequence out of scope). Starts once the discharge conveyor is enabled; holds during shutdown until the feed conveyor has shut down (REQ-003/004).
Shredder Automatic Control

Cyclone filter unit (FilterUnitInst1). Remote-operational feedback and reset brought in; fault taken from the inverse of the system-OK signal (REQ-019). Running feedback NOT wired - its source tag DiscreteInputs.'CycloneDustAutoRunning/Stop' contains a '/' and is un-referenceable in IR (C-005 violation in the given DB); see report. Fan up-to-speed from the plant fan-start time (REQ-020). Runs with the plant; holds until fans-shutdown-ready (REQ-003).
Cyclone Filter Unit Automatic Control
Discharge conveyor (MotorStarterInst9). Gated by the general enable (REQ-013); holds during shutdown until the shredder has shut down (REQ-003).
Discharge Conveyor Automatic Control
